entity_id.description: If set, scope centrality to subgraph around this node
entity_id.title: Entity Id

degraded.description: True when an LLM call (question generation or evaluation) failed, so the verdict rests on fallback questions / forced 'inconclusive' rather than a full chain-of-verification.
degraded.title: Degraded

entity_id.description: Node ID to check for contradictions
entity_id.title: Entity Id

status.description: Service status: healthy, degraded, or unhealthy
status.title: Status

effective_weight.description: The weight this component actually contributed. Equals `weight` when nothing was inapplicable; 0.0 for a component that holds no number; larger than `weight` when it absorbed an inapplicable component's share. Present so a renormalized composite stays auditable from the response alone.
effective_weight.title: Effective Weight

score.description: None when this component holds no number. A null score is NOT a low score — read `status` to learn whether it was unmeasurable (backend outage) or inapplicable (nothing to measure).
score.title: Score

status.description: 'measured' — `score` is a real value. 'not_applicable' — the metric is undefined for this entity (e.g. no incoming edges), so its weight is redistributed over the applicable components. 'unavailable' — the measurement failed, so the composite is null and is never persisted.
status.title: Status

weight.description: Configured weight, as supplied by settings. Never rescaled.
weight.title: Weight

weighted_score.description: None when `score` is None — there is nothing to weight.
weighted_score.title: Weighted Score

entity_id.description: Node ID to compute integrity score for
entity_id.title: Entity Id

write_back.description: Write integrity score back to the knowledge graph node
write_back.title: Write Back

degraded.description: True exactly when `integrity_score` is null — either a component could not be measured, or no positive component was applicable at all. Read `degraded_reason` for which. An entity with nothing to cite is NOT degraded.
degraded.title: Degraded

degraded_components.description: Names of the components that could not be measured (status 'unavailable'). May be empty on a degraded response when the cause was that nothing was applicable rather than that something failed.
degraded_components.title: Degraded Components

degraded_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the composite could not be computed.
degraded_reason.title: Degraded Reason

integrity_score.description: None when at least one component could not be MEASURED, or when no positive component was applicable at all. A null score is NOT a low score and is never written back to the graph. An entity that merely has nothing to cite still receives a real score — see not_applicable_components.
integrity_score.title: Integrity Score

not_applicable_components.description: Names of the components whose metric is undefined for this entity (status 'not_applicable'). NOT a degradation: the composite is renormalized over the remaining components and IS persisted. Populated even on a degraded response, so the two reasons stay distinguishable.
not_applicable_components.title: Not Applicable Components

degraded.description: True when one or more metrics could not be computed (backend outage / malformed response). Null metrics are NOT real scores.
degraded.title: Degraded

entity_id.description: Central node ID for subgraph extraction
entity_id.title: Entity Id

relationship_types.description: Filter by relationship types (e.g. SUPPORTS, REFUTES)
relationship_types.title: Relationship Types
